label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows through param.replace('-->') to safe, then written to response.getWriter() within HTML comment delimiters. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. While '-->' is stripped, this incomplete sanitization allows XSS payloads like '<script>alert(1)</script><!--' to reach the sink. HTML comments do not block script execution in all contexts, and the sanitize pattern is insufficient to prevent XSS exploitation.

evidence.note: User input param -> replace('-->') -> safe -> response.getWriter() sink
